clips.text: Hi Eric! I'm Pip. Let's grow a little math magic!
How many berries can you see? Touch each berry once to count it. Then tap its number.
Two little baskets! How many berries are there altogether? You can touch them to count.
Some carrots went to the picnic! Count the bright carrots that stayed. How many are left?
Which basket has more berries? Tap the button under that basket. If they match, tap the same button.
Which basket has fewer berries? Tap the button under that basket. If they match, tap the same button.
Ooh, a little pattern! Look at what repeats. Which picture comes next?
Let's count together! Touch each berry just once. The last number you say tells how many berries there are.
Put one berry in for each number you count. Stop at the number on your card. You can tap a berry to take it out.
Zero means none. An empty basket has zero berries. Nothing needs to go in!
Start with the first basket. Count those berries, then keep counting the berries in the next basket. That makes the total!
The faded carrots have gone to the picnic. Leave those alone. Count only the bright carrots that are still here.
Try matching one berry from each basket. The basket with extra berries has more. If no berries are extra, they have the same number.
Try matching one berry from each basket. The basket that runs out first has fewer. If they both run out together, they have the same number.
Say the pictures out loud. Listen for the little part that repeats. Then keep that part going!
No rush, little explorer. Let's look together. You can touch the pictures, or ask me for a hint!
Lovely thinking! A little seed for your garden.
You found it! Your garden is growing, one discovery at a time.
You figured it out! Here comes a happy little garden seed.
You kept trying, and you figured it out! That is how we learn. A seed for your garden!
Five little seeds! Look what you grew! A flower for your garden, and a new friend to explore with.
Five more little discoveries! Your beautiful garden has another flower. Look how much it is growing!
Welcome to your number playground! Tap plus to add a berry. Tap minus to take one out. What can you discover?
Here is your discovery!
Plus.
Take away.
Equals.
Leaf.
Flower.
Berry.
Star.
Can you find a circle? Tap your little shape friend.
A circle is round, like a little wheel. It has no corners.
Can you find a triangle? Tap your little shape friend.
A triangle has three straight sides and three corners. Trace them with your finger. One, two, three!
Can you find a square? Tap your little shape friend.
A square has four equal sides. Look for a shape with four sides that are all the same length.
Can you find a long rectangle? Tap your little shape friend.
Look for a long rectangle. It has four corners, with two longer sides and two shorter sides.
Can you find a hexagon? Tap your little shape friend.
A hexagon has six straight sides. Take your time and count all six sides.
Can you make zero berries? An empty basket has zero. Tap All done when you are ready.
